title: SIH26123 Benchmark Metrics Schema
description: One entry per benchmark run. Used by run_experiment, degradation_sweep, and the verifier that checks report numbers against these files.

run_id.description: Unique id for this run, e.g. 'pibt_token-seed7-r5'.

system.description: Which system produced this run — our system or a baseline.

tick_limit.description: Hard cap on run length. If the run hits this without finishing, finished_within_limit is false and improvement_pct must be null.

completion_ticks.description: Tick at which all tasks completed. Null if finished_within_limit is false.

vertex_collisions.description: Two robots occupying the same cell at the same tick. Must be 0 for pibt_token in every run — this is the PS's hard requirement, not an average.

edge_collisions.description: Two robots swapping cells across one tick.

deadlocks_detected.description: Reported for baselines. Should be structurally impossible (always 0) for pibt_token, not just empirically low.

total_distance.description: Sum of cells moved across all robots.

claim_conflicts.description: Sum, across all robots, of `TaskLayer::claim_conflicts()` — how many times a robot's own task commitment disagreed with the token's recorded claimant and had to be reconciled (`docs/decisions.md`'s claim-reconciliation decision entry, closing the Step 1B token-fork finding). Only `pibt_token` accumulates this (`stop_and_wait` doesn't use the token protocol). Currently always 0 for `run_experiment`/`degradation_sweep`'s own in-process harness, since neither yet injects token-level loss (only real-transport runs and the dedicated property test in `tests/token_passing.rs` do) — present so the field is populated the moment a harness does.

token_skips.description: Sum, across all robots, of `TaskLayer::skip_count()` — how many times a robot exhausted its delivery backoff budget to a peer and skipped it (Amendment B, `docs/decisions.md`'s Fix 1 entry). Only meaningful over real transport (`run_one_cycle`); always 0 for the in-process `new_pure` path `run_experiment.rs`/`degradation_sweep.rs` use, since that path has no backoff/delivery concept at all.

comms.description: Present for degradation_sweep runs. Omitted or zeroed for clean baseline runs.

mode_occupancy.description: Fraction of total robot-ticks spent in each mode. Should sum to ~1.0. Only meaningful for pibt_token.

comparable_to_baseline.description: False if this run (or the baseline it's compared against) didn't finish inside tick_limit. When false, improvement_pct MUST be null — never compute a percentage against an unfinished run.

improvement_pct.description: Task-completion-time improvement vs. stop_and_wait on the same seed/map. Null when comparable_to_baseline is false.
